selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: curl was initially 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8; the hold was applied and verified through both apt-mark and dpkg before and after restart.

Captured boot ID 4b43f122-6c8b-4c87-b01a-12705c4a9f4f, acknowledged the scheduled restart, observed new boot ID d129d7cd-a574-482e-ac42-7e431a9f2187, and confirmed the system was running with curl functional and its hold intact.

commands.command: printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'curl_binary='; curl --version | head -n 1; dpkg-query -W -f='package=${binary:Package} status=${db:Status-Abbrev} version=${Version}\n' curl; printf 'hold_before='; apt-mark showhold | grep -x curl || printf 'none\n'; apt-cache policy curl | sed -n '1,8p'
